format_divergence.reason_en: This module is receptive. A production or transform question would ask the learner to build Hindi, which the module never teaches and the app never checks, and an error-spot question would present a wrong Hindi sentence to someone whose only job is to understand correct spoken Hindi. The two formats the module actually teaches — comprehension and gap-fill — are what it should be assessed on. Flagged rather than adopted silently: if the engine requires the Part F mix across all modules, this needs a ruling.
format_divergence.replay_note: Every question carries replay_item_id so the player knows which dialogue audio to serve. Gap-fill questions also carry line_n.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Why have the two neighbours not seen each other?
options: One of them has been busy with work
They live in different buildings now
questions.explanation_en: काम में लगा था — he has been tied up with work.

questions.question_en: Listen again. What does the shopkeeper tell the customer to do?
questions.explanation_en: शाम को आ जाइए — come back in the evening, once the bread is in.

questions.question_en: Across the three clothes-shop dialogues, what item is being discussed?
questions.explanation_en: कमीज़, a shirt — and it is named only once, in the very first line of the level. Everything after that is feminine endings pointing back at it.

questions.question_en: You hear कल आपने चीनी नहीं दी थी. Why आपने rather than आप?
options: Because the sentence is a question
Because देना is transitive and the tense is perfective
questions.explanation_en: ने marks the subject of a perfective transitive verb. The same thing happens in the market dialogue: कल मैंने पचास में ली थी.

questions.question_en: कोई बात नहीं turns up in several of these dialogues. What is it doing?
questions.explanation_en: It waves away whatever has just gone slightly wrong — no change, no bread, a wrong size. It is one of the most useful phrases in the module.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: मैं कल ही ___ हूँ।
questions.explanation_en: Seema is speaking about herself, so the verb is feminine singular.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: दो मिनट ___ ।
questions.explanation_en: मिनट is masculine plural here, so the verb is plural.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: ट्रैफ़िक में फँस ___ था।
questions.explanation_en: A male speaker and no ने, so the vector agrees with the subject.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: आजकल ___ के दाम बहुत बढ़ गए हैं।
questions.question_read_as: aajkal ___ ke daam bahut baṛh gae haiṁ.
questions.explanation_en: के is a postposition, so the plural goes oblique.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: मटर इस मौसम ___ मिलती है?
questions.explanation_en: A season is something you are inside, so में.
